title: Root-seq replay cache is volatile: captured still-unexpired signed DIO replays as Verified after reboot (spec 8.10.1 anti-replay gap)
description: Found in security review of b7z9.88.3 (receive.rs verify_dio_root_signature). rust/lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/receive.rs:731: RootSeqCache is in-memory only; cached() returns None after reboot, so a radio adversary can replay a captured still-valid signed DIO (root_seq=N) and it passes the strictly-increasing gate and is accept()ed as Verified — defeating the spec 06 8.10.1 MUST-reject-replay guarantee exactly across the reboot boundary. Persistence infra exists and is already used for DAO replay (MemStorage vs durable storage split) — the DIO root-sig cache was never wired in. Impact bound: window closes at signature expiry (receive.rs:715); Verified and Baseline are treated identically downstream (receive.rs:522-548) today, but anti-replay is the option's stated purpose. Fix shape: persist root-seq high-water marks (keyed dodag_id+instance) through the same storage path used for DAO replay state; consider replay-window/epoch binding if storage is unavailable.
close_reason: Fixed: RootSeqCache gains RSQ1 redundant-slot persistence (open/resume/persist in lichen-rpl root_seq_cache.rs, mirrors DRX2/DTX2 pattern); all 4 RplStack constructors resume it (provision_leaf resumes root-seq FIRST to stay retryable across transient faults); verify_dio_root_signature now persists the high-water mark BEFORE admitting it in-memory (persist fault degrades to Baseline, never Reject, no cache burn); corrupt records fail constructors closed. Pins: verified_signed_dio_replay_rejects_after_reopen (the bug), signed_dio_persist_failure_degrades_to_baseline_without_burn, corrupt_root_seq_record_fails_provision_closed + 6 lichen-rpl persistence_tests. lichen-rpl 259+13 green; lichen-node 344 passed/18 failed (failure set bit-identical to pre-change baseline stash test); lichen-gateway green; clippy clean in touched files. NOTE: opencode run reviewer (kimi-k3) timed out 4x (10min/4min limits), so the 3 review passes (correctness/security/edge) were done by the implementer; found+fixed one P2 (provision ordering) and reverted fmt churn.
